note: Upload packages for the hand-off (S49). Paths: 'repo:' = relative to the repository checkout that holds the data (R2AI root), 'abs:' = absolute. 'as' = path inside the tar. Every package is extracted into the root of a checkout; the layout then matches data/ and out/runs/ of the repository. 'copy' packages are shipped as they are (already a tar).

packages.name: r2ai-data-canonical
packages.role: canonical corpus (vi + zh, 887,151 docs), t256 chunks, BGE-M3 chunk vectors

packages.name: r2ai-data-120ask
packages.role: 120ask segments crawled in S37 (docs, chunks, vectors, C-max top-3)

packages.name: r2ai-data-en-pubmed
packages.role: English PubMed abstracts lane (Europe PMC), needed only for the EN-hedge copy (4_120A-en3)

packages.name: r2ai-runs-inputs
packages.role: doc-level BGE-M3 vectors, Pharmacity lots, query vectors, scorer script, rh100 rehearsal, model pins

packages.name: r2ai-s49-inputs
packages.role: 120A and CH-rrf rebuild inputs: K_q / K90 per query (from the P1-vi+10 approval audit), P1 chunk texts of 120A and of CH-rrf, the audit itself

packages.name: r2ai-submissions
packages.role: the private submissions (4 sent + 5_120A-en10) and two reference rebuilds (R0, 120A-nop1), to compare SHA256

packages.name: r2ai-runs-scores
packages.role: every reranker score file of the public run (4B, C-max 0.6B, Jina, S29 0.6B), pools and pair registries; paths out/runs/...

packages.name: r2ai-runs-meta
packages.role: run manifests, calibration json (cal.json, ef2-free.json), build reports and logs of the runs behind the submissions; paths out/runs/...
